result.topic_en: Gauss considers the curve x^3 + y^3 = 1 and its differential relation, tabulates values of an associated integral (with values at x = 1 and x = infinity), and sums a series beginning 0.79370058 to obtain 0.883284704.

methods.what: Differential relation on the curve x^3+y^3=1 (equal elements of the associated integral)
Second differential relation for a related substitution
Table of numerical values of the integral at x = 0.1, 1 and infinity
Summation of a convergent series term by term, beginning with 0.79370058 (= 2^{-1/3}), giving the value 0.8833 at x = 1
